title: Committed snapshot citations replace the gitignored retention cache; ADR-0013 5th amendment
description: ODOC-231 Decision §2 + Amendments 1-4 (same ADR). Replace the .lore/cache/snapshots/1 gitignored/machine-local/16-capped retention cache with committed citations. One file per citation at .lore/snapshots/1/<kind>/<scope-key>/<name>.json (Amendment 1 §4-5: scope-keyed path, format-version segment survives at the path level, human name stays the filename). Fields: repositories[] (min 1, Amendment 1 §1 - single-repo is a one-element array, never a separate flat shape), commit, docs_tree_sha, projection_digest, schema_version, lore_version, recorded_at, actor. projection_digest lets lore re-derive and assert the projection at commit reproduces it. Verification has three outcomes: verified/failed/cannot-be-checked-from-here (Amendment 1 §3), distinguishable in the exit code. Citation name charset: ASCII lowercase alphanumerics + hyphen only, no leading hyphen, bounded length at both ends measured against the full path, must contain at least one hyphen (Amendment 4 ruling 11 - this alone excludes all Windows reserved device names by shape), validated on READ not just creation (Amendment 1 §6). Windows reserved-name list (CON/PRN/AUX/NUL/COM1-9/LPT1-9 plus COM0/LPT0 as a margin, Amendment 3) stays as defence-in-depth only, per Amendment 4. Cap of 16 (SNAPSHOT_RETENTION_LIMIT, src/core/snapshot.ts:19) is removed entirely, not raised. Also fix src/commands/snapshot.ts:77's hardcoded maximum: 16 (drifts from the constant; moot once the cap is removed, ADR Downstream records says fix rather than leave). Land lore-cli's own 5th ADR-0013 amendment recording .lore/snapshots/ as a new committed member (four members already committed per current ADR-0013: config.toml, sync-state.json, .lore/agents/, profile.toml - no .gitignore change needed, .lore/ itself is not ignored, only cache/explorer/archive/cutover are). Workspace citations (multi-repo) additionally need: the duplicate-detection note in Amendment 1 SS8 (citation records which member it was taken in; from a single member, uniqueness is UNVERIFIABLE, third-outcome, not a false pass).

acceptanceCriteria.text: Citations are committed at .lore/snapshots/1/<kind>/<scope>/<name>.json with repositories[] (min 1), commit, docs_tree_sha, projection_digest, schema_version, lore_version, recorded_at, actor
Name validation (charset, no leading hyphen, length bounds, mandatory hyphen) is enforced on read, not only at creation
Verification reports three distinguishable outcomes (verified/failed/cannot-check) in the exit code, never collapsing the third into a pass or a fail
SNAPSHOT_RETENTION_LIMIT and the cap of 16 are removed; commands/snapshot.ts no longer hardcodes maximum: 16
A 5th ADR-0013 amendment is landed in this repo recording .lore/snapshots/ as a committed member
A workspace citation records the member repo it was taken in; uniqueness checked from a single member reports the third outcome, never a false pass
